source: Previously consumed CKAD08 native witness checkpoints and CKAD05 stored fact planes, authenticated by original result.json checkpoint pins; CKAD02 evaluator used only for already consumed held-query scoring. No original source episode, virgin seed or factual resource rescan.

stages.A: Import exact CKAD05 stored facts; no relation-family label supplied.
stages.B: 128 witnessed rows each in slots0,1; correlation-only packet rejection negative.
stages.C: 128 witnessed rows each in slots2,3, with evidence-selected degree.
stages.D: 128 witnessed rows each in slots4,5; conflicting same-input update to slot5 quarantines it; facts and unaffected prior readouts must survive; preserve rejected outcomes.
stages.E: Score unseen slots6,7 BEFORE adaptation, then acquire128 witnesses each and score unfamiliar inputs. This is bounded family adaptation, not zero-shot success.
stages.F: Resume cold D/E state, add384 unseen witnesses to slots0-4,6,7 to reach512, using deterministic information-seeking choice among cached witnessed inputs; slot5 stays quarantined.

ordering: CKAD12 SHA input_order initial128 per slot. Continued queries prefer provisional-unknown inputs then unseen action alternatives to known contexts then SHA order; outcomes unavailable to selector until selected.
